SELECT CASE WHEN name='睡眠统计来源选择' THEN 'get_sleep_statistics' ELSE name END AS tool, COUNT(*) AS count FROM agent_steps WHERE status='FAILED' AND AND name IN ('睡眠统计来源选择','get_sleep_statistics','get_profile','get_plans','search_knowledge','get_authorized_diary') GROUP BY tool ORDER BY count DESC,tool
mapper.sql: COUNT(*) AS batches,COUNT(CASE WHEN status='CONFIRMED' THEN 1 END) AS confirmed, COALESCE(SUM(total_rows),0) AS input_rows,COALESCE(SUM(inserted_rows),0) AS inserted_rows
mapper.select: SELECT 'SLEEP' AS kind,b.batches,b.confirmed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rejected_imports WHERE kind='SLEEP' AND ) AS rejected, b.input_rows,b.inserted_rows FROM (SELECT FROM import_batches WHERE ) b UNION ALL SELECT 'STEPS',b.batches,b.confirmed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rejected_imports WHERE kind='STEPS' AND ), b.input_rows,b.inserted_rows FROM (SELECT FROM step_import_batches WHERE ) b

SELECT COUNT(*) AS scheduled,COUNT(c.id) AS completed FROM plan_items i JOIN plans p ON p.id=i.plan_id LEFT JOIN checkins c ON c.item_id=i.id AND c.date=i.date WHERE i.retired=FALSE AND i.date >= #{start} AND i.date < #{until}
